card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit partway through a multi-digit number, often just before a final 0 or 60, such as years, centuries, seconds, msec or ISO 9660. Also a space before a number.

modes.label: Years and centuries
modes.description: A middle digit inside a year or century number.

modes.label: Lab and ECG limits
modes.description: The first digit of a threshold like 60 or 70 before msec or seconds.

modes.label: Technical standard numbers
modes.description: A digit inside ISO 9660 style numbers.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a longer number, like a year or a 60 msec limit, where the next digit is likely a zero.
